resources.string: All buttons go to the tester. Hold Start + Select for 2 s, or tap Close, to leave. The stick rings follow each side\'s activity.
Input daemon not reachable: normal buttons are shown and B or Back leaves. Start + Select and the LED reaction need ashfall-rp5-input.
The input daemon refused GRAB: Home, Back and Select may still reach the system.
Put the handheld down, let go of both sticks and the triggers, then press Start to capture the centre position.
Roll both sticks slowly around their full circle a few times, then press Start. You can take as long as you need.
Squeeze L2 and R2 all the way in and release them twice, then press Start.
Check that every range looks sane. Nothing is written until you press Save.
Samples: %1$d — hold still and press Start when the sticks are at rest
Left travel %1$d · right travel %2$d — press Start when you have rolled both sticks
L2 travel %1$d · R2 travel %2$d — press Start when both triggers have been pulled fully
Drawn RP5 outline, every button via GRAB, live sticks, triggers and LED reaction
While the tester is open it takes every button from ashfall-rp5-input: A/B/X/Y, shoulders, L3/R3, D-pad, Start, Select, Home and Back. Leave with Start + Select (2 s) or Close.

Deadzones are applied by ashfall-rp5-input after calibration, so every app and emulator sees them. The tester reads raw MCU values, which is why it can show buttons that Android would normally consume.
